mapper.select: SELECT rvas.finprod_id as assetFinprodId, fp.finprod_type2 as finprodType2, decode(fp.finprod_type2,'F01',SUM(rvas.security_quantity),SUM(rvas.smv)) as valAmout FROM RSK_VALTBL_ASSET_SUB rvas LEFT join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.finprod_id=rvas.finprod_id WHERE rvas.ptl_id =#{ptlId} AND rvas.val_date =TO_DATE(#{valDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND rvas.finprod_id=#{finprodId} AND rvas.finprod_id IS NOT NULL and length(rvas.sub_code)>8 GROUP BY rvas.finprod_id,fp.finprod_type2

SELECT rvas.finprod_id as assetFinprodId, fp.finprod_type2 as finprodType2, SUM(rvas.smv) as valAmout FROM RSK_VALTBL_ASSET_SUB rvas LEFT join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.finprod_id=rvas.finprod_id WHERE rvas.ptl_id =#{ptlId} AND rvas.val_date =TO_DATE(#{valDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND rvas.finprod_id IS NOT NULL and length(rvas.sub_code)>8 GROUP BY rvas.finprod_id,fp.finprod_type2

SELECT eew.ENTRUST_ID as entrustId, eewd.PORTFOLIO_ID as portfolioId, eew.FINPROD_ID as bottomAssetId, eew.FINPROD_TYPE2 as finprodType2, eew.PS as ps, eewd.PORTFOLIO_AMT as amount FROM ETR_ENTRUST_WW eew LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST_WW_DETAIL eewd ON eewd.entrust_id =eew.entrust_id WHERE eew.portfolio_id=#{ptlId} AND eew.ENTRUST_DATE <=TO_DATE(#{valDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND eew.ENTRUST_STATUS=#{entrustStatus}
mapper.insert: insert into VAL_TABLE_IMP_RISK ( TRADEID, WW_PORTFOLIOID, PORTFOLIOID, FINPRODID, PS, EVENTDATE, ASSETTYPE, AMOUNT, CREDIT_AMOUNT ) values (#{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{wwPortfolioid,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{portfolioId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ps,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{eventDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{assetType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{amount,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{creditAmount,jdbcType=DECIMAL} )
mapper.select: SELECT TRADEID AS tradeId, WW_PORTFOLIOID AS wwPortfolioid, PORTFOLIOID AS portfolioId, FINPRODID AS finprodId, PS AS ps, EVENTDATE AS eventDate, ASSETTYPE AS assetType, AMOUNT AS amount, nvl(CREDIT_AMOUNT,AMOUNT) AS creditAmount FROM VAL_TABLE_IMP_RISK WHERE WW_PORTFOLIOID= #{ptlId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND EVENTDATE <= TO_DATE(#{valDate},'YYYY-MM-DD')
